config.notes: Two page kinds. (1) www.unsw.edu.au/study/... degree pages (text): key-details strip prints Delivery Mode, Campus, Codes (Program code, CRICOS code), then two fee panels in order domestic then international: "Fees 2026 Indicative first year full fee $X* 2026 Indicative full fee to complete degree $Y*" twice; the adapter takes the SECOND panel first-year fee (international, first-year = annual). Commencing Terms prints terms only ("Term 1, 2 & 3"); Duration follows. IELTS is not printed per program (selector only); central rule at https://www.unsw.edu.au/study/how-to-apply/english-language-requirements (by faculty). (2) www.handbook.unsw.edu.au program pages (Firecrawl-rendered copies only): Campus, Study Level, Typical duration, Delivery Mode, Intake Period (Term 1, Term 2, Term 3, Summer Term), AQF Level; no fees, no IELTS. Term months from the UNSW academic calendar https://www.unsw.edu.au/student/managing-your-studies/key-dates/academic-calendar for 2027 (T1 15 Feb, T2 31 May, T3 13 Sep, Summer U1 4 Jan; in 2026 T2 began 1 Jun). From 2028 UNSW moves to a flex-semester calendar (S1 28 Feb, S2 14 Aug) - the mapping must be revised then. No json_source on purpose (would send 22 Firecrawl-refused pages back for re-render). International view (5 Oct 13:02 review): the plain (direct) fetch of www.unsw.edu.au/study/... degree pages already holds both the domestic and the international fee panels, Commencing Terms and Delivery Mode; the domestic/international switch is a client-side modal with no address parameter, so page_view is left empty and no Firecrawl is needed. IELTS is behind a client-side selector (not printed). title_strip/course_title_strip drop " in "/" of " so "Diploma in X" matches the page "Diploma of X". page_view (5 Oct 13:02): left empty. A render-only view for 78 handbook pages was tried and withdrawn: UNSW is not a Firecrawl target university, so the reader cannot render them (they went to needs_render). Entry requirement (5 Oct 15:22, for review, not admitted): degree pages "Assumed knowledge" (undergraduate) or "For entry into this degree, students must have:" / "The minimum entry requirement for ... is:" (postgraduate); handbook "Minimum Entry Requirements" block. Exit awards: no "N years of full-time study" exit wording on stored pages (one page says students "can exit with that award" without years), so no exit_awards pattern. Fees: every degree page prints an indicative first-year (annual) international fee beside the full fee to complete the degree, so no whole-course fee pattern is needed.
